For A=b=0 the unchanged decoder has exact asymptotic sqrt(N) trace error kappa=(1/2)E|h0-Eh0|>0, h0=2r^2/3+64r^6/45.
Known rational parameters admit direct finite-bit Gaussian rejection plus native local preparation at this N^-1/2 approximation scale, with polylog classical overhead at fixed bounds.
